def execute_banish_warframe(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Limbo moves targeted allies or enemies between the material and Rift planes, damaging hostiles and altering their ability to interact across planes.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    destination = resolve_valid_destination(target_or_point)
    if not permitted_by_spatial_rules(actor,destination): return DENIED
    safe_destination = find_collision_free_placement(actor,destination)
    move_actor_atomically(actor,safe_destination)
    replicate_teleport_with_visual_event(actor)
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
